verdict.rationale: The evidence documents liveness checks, face-to-ID matching within a single session, document authentication, and per-session risk scores for email and phone. Nothing shows cross-verification detection of the same face or document resurfacing under different names. Session-level face matching and reusable 'verify once' identity are different capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, the platform detects repeat and duplicate identities across verifications — the same face or document resurfacing under different names is flagged automatically
